name: Text Field
desc: Tier: Molecule. Use Filled or Outlined for text entry and Dropdown for one choice from 7+ options. Avoid using Radio for 7+ choices. Dependencies: Typography, Semantic color, Spacing, Shape. Accessibility: persistent labels, visible focus, error text, and 48dp targets.

name: Text Area
desc: Tier: Molecule. Multi-line text entry with Default, Focused, Error and Disabled states. Do not use for short values. Uses local Semantic, Spacing, Shape and Typography tokens.

name: Checkbox
desc: Tier: Atom. Independent selection control for multi-select and consent. Includes Default, Focused, Pressed, Disabled and Error states with a 48dp target. Built from local tokens.

name: Switch
desc: Tier: Atom. Use: Use for an immediately applied binary setting. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage.

name: Radio
desc: Tier: Atom. Single-choice control for 2–6 visible options; use Dropdown for 7+. Includes Default, Focused, Pressed, Disabled and Error states with a 48dp target. Built from local tokens.

name: Button
desc: Tier: Atom. Use: Use for actions: Filled for primary, Tonal for secondary, Outlined for alternatives, Text for low emphasis. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Leading icon: turn on Show Leading Icon and pick it with the Leading Icon swap (18 dp, same color as the label), e.g. add for "New playlist". Style=Neutral: gray pill (surface_container_highest) with an on_surface label for low-emphasis actions such as "More" in section headers.

name: Icon Button
desc: Tier: Atom. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Style=Tonal: neutral circle (surface_container_highest) for secondary actions such as Share on the player. Style=Inverse: on_surface circle with a surface icon for the primary Play action (player controls use it at 64 dp, the mini player at 40 dp).

name: Filter Chip
desc: Tier: Atom. Use: Use for choosing among 2–6 visible filters. Avoid: Do not use for 7 or more options; use Select/Dropdown. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage.

desc: Tier: Atom. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage.

Actions: Notifications and Community Icon Buttons (exposed, 48 dp) and the Profile Avatar with a plan badge ("plus").

name: Playlist App Bar
desc: Tier: Organism. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Leading Collapse (expand_more Icon Button) closes the full player; trailing AI Mix Toggle = label + sparkle + Switch (exposed).

name: Status Bar
desc: Tier: Organism. Purpose: Android system status bar shown at the top of every screen mockup (time, Wi-Fi, signal, battery). Usage Rules: first full-bleed row of a 375 dp screen, above the app bar; set Time from the source screen; transparent so the screen surface shows through. Avoid: app actions here. Accessibility: decorative system chrome, not interactive; text on_surface keeps 4.5:1 on every surface.

name: Mini Player
desc: Tier: Organism. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Like (Standard Icon Button, 48 dp) and Play (Inverse Icon Button, 40 dp visual inside the 64 dp row) are exposed.

name: Playback Progress
desc: Tier: Molecule. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage.

name: Playback Controls
desc: Tier: Organism. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens.  Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Controls are Icon Button instances (exposed): Like, Previous, Play (Style=Inverse, 64 dp, 36 dp icon), Next, Download (cloud_download). Swap Play to pause while playing.

name: Player Utility Bar
desc: Tier: Molecule. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage.

name: Section Header
desc: Tier: Molecule. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Title Stack: title plus optional supporting text (Show Supporting Text). More is a Tonal Button (Show More), exposed so its label can change. Set instances to Fill width.

name: Shortcut Card
desc: Tier: Molecule. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage.

name: Media Carousel
desc: Tier: Organism. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage.

name: Library Shortcut Tile
desc: Tier: Molecule (Icon + Label). Purpose: category shortcut in the Library screen (Likes, Downloads, Created for you, Your uploads, Saved, Your New Podcasts). Usage Rules: use 3 or 4 in an equal-width row (instances set to Fill); Color picks the category accent (Purple=tertiary, Cyan, Magenta, Yellow) for the icon only; the label stays on_surface; wrap to 2 lines centered. Avoid: using it for media with artwork (use Shortcut Card). Accessibility: whole tile is the touch target (min 80x80 dp, above 48 dp); label is the accessible name; accent icons are decorative, meaning is in the label.

name: Media Card
desc: Tier: Molecule (Artwork + Track Metadata or description). Purpose: one item in a horizontal media rail on Explore. Usage Rules: Size=Default (136 dp artwork, title + subtitle) for songs, albums and artists; Size=Large (156 dp artwork, one-line description) for mixes such as "Your Weekly Mixtape"; Show Badge marks explicit content (E). Put cards in a horizontal row that clips at the screen edge; never squash them. Accessibility: the card is one touch target (min 136 dp wide); title is the accessible name; the E badge also needs an accessibility label "Explicit".

name: Track Metadata
desc: Tier: Molecule. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Subtitle icon: optional 16 dp icon before the subtitle (e.g. cloud_done for a downloaded playlist). Title and subtitle are one line with ellipsis; set the instance to Fill width.

name: Playlist List Item
desc: Tier: Molecule. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Trailing More (more_vert Icon Button, 48 dp) opens the playlist menu; Track Metadata is exposed so title, subtitle and the downloaded icon are set from the parent. Set instances to Fill width.

name: Podcast Episode Card
desc: Tier: Organism. Use: Use as a reusable design-system building block. Avoid: Do not detach or redraw it in product screens. Dependencies: Semantic color, Spacing, Shape, and Typography tokens. Accessibility: Use accessible labels and preserve minimum 48dp touch targets for interactive usage. Footer: Progress Indicator (100 dp, exposed so the listened part can be set) + Time Left text, then Download (optional) and More Icon Buttons. Description wraps to 2 lines with ellipsis. Set instances to Fill width.

name: List Header
desc: Tier: Molecule (Sort Icon + Title + Dropdown Icon, Outlined Button). Purpose: header above a sortable list, e.g. "Playlists" with "New playlist" in the Library. Usage Rules: the sort control (48 dp tall) opens the sort menu; the Action Button (exposed) holds the main list action with a leading icon; hide it with Show Action when the list has none. Set instances to Fill width. Accessibility: sort control and button are 48 dp targets; the sort control announces the current sort ("Playlists, sort by recent").

name: Dialog
desc: Tier: Organism. Basic and List modal dialogs for focused blocking decisions. Avoid for non-blocking messages; use Snackbar. Built from local Button instances and tokens.

name: Sheet
desc: Tier: Organism. Bottom and Side sheet containers for supplemental tasks and details. Avoid for blocking confirmations. Uses local tokens.
